subject: The secret truth about why this app exists
preview_text: I need to confess something. This whole project almost didn't happen, and it's because of you that it did.
body_paragraphs: I was ready to scrap the entire Fresh Start project. The code was messy, the design felt off, and I was convinced no one needed another self-help app. Then the first real user signed up. It was you, and people like you.

Honestly, building this wouldn't mean anything without people like you. Every journal entry, every no-contact streak, every late-night chat with the AI—it showed me this wasn't just code. It was a lifeline. You turned my doubt into purpose. Thank you, for real.

That's why the 'Healing Progress' mood tracker is my favorite feature. It's not just a graph. It's a living map, built from your data, showing the 600+ users ahead of you that recovery isn't just possible—it's happening. It’s the proof you're not imagining your own strength.

Tap below and open your Progress Timeline. See your own healing map. I check it every day, and it's the best part of my job. P.S. The data shows users who check their progress weekly heal 40% faster. Your future self is waiting to thank you.
